title: 2024年6月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
paperTitle: 2024年6月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
passage: It's well known that physical exercise is beneficial not just to physical health but also to mental health. Yet whereas most countries have ,  {{1}} evidence-backed guidelines on the type and intensity of exercise {{2}}  for various physical health benefits, such guidelines do not yet exist for exercise and mood. This is  {{3}} due to a lack of necessary evidence. However, a new systematic review brings us usefully up to-date on the current findings in this area. Before  {{4}} into some of the key take-aways, an important  {{5}} made in the review is between aerobic exercise and anaerobic. The former  {{6}} such things as walking, jogging and cycling and means exercising in such a way that your body is able to use oxygen to burn fat for energy. In contrast, anaerobic exercise—such as lifting heavy weights—is of such {{7}}  intensity that your body does not have time to use oxygen to create energy and so instead it breaks down glucose(葡萄糖) in your blood or muscles. Beginning first with the influence of exercise intensity on the mood benefits of aerobic exercise, the researchers, led by John Chan at Shenzhen University, found {{8}}  results from 19 relevant studies. Some favoured higher intensity, others low, while seven studies found that intensity made no {{9}}  to mood benefits. In relation to the intensity of anaerobic exercise, however, the results were far clearer—the optimum(最佳选择) for improving mood is {{10}}  intensity, perhaps because low intensity is too dull while high intensity is too unpleasant.

blanks.explain:
【词性槽】have ___, evidence-backed guidelines，修饰 guidelines

【依据】与 evidence-backed 并列修饰"指南"，最贴的是"详细的" guidelines 的常见修饰是"详细的、有循证支撑的"——detailed, evidence-backed guidelines 正是常见地道搭配；且与下文 such guidelines do not yet exist for exercise and mood 形成"运动健身的指南详尽，但情绪方向还没有"的对比。

【竞争词】B) contradictory "相互矛盾的指南"逻辑不通 contradictory 表"自相矛盾的"，作者要赞大多数国家有靠谱的指南，不会说"自相矛盾"。 J) moderate moderate 修饰"强度"而非"指南" moderate 在本文专指"中等强度"（见 35 题），用来修饰 guidelines 既不搭配也无意义。 O) vigorous vigorous 修饰"运动"，不修饰"指南" vigorous 常与 exercise/activity 搭配表"剧烈的"，无法形容指南文本。 34 35

【词性槽】the type and intensity of exercise ___ for various…，后置定语动词

【依据】be required for = 为……所必需 原句要表达"为获得各种身体健康益处所需要的运动种类与强度"——guidelines on the type and intensity of exercise required for…physical health benefits，required for 与 "for various physical health benefits" 自然搭配。

【竞争词】K) notified notify 的对象是人，不是"运动" notify 表"通知（某人）"，主语通常是"通知的内容"，而"运动被通知"语义荒谬；且 notified for 也非地道搭配，应是 notified of/about。

【词性槽】be 动词 + ___ + due to，空处修饰整个表语

【依据】下文转折"However"暗示"部分原因"而非全部 空后是 due to a lack of necessary evidence. However, a new systematic review brings us usefully up to-date on the current findings in this area.，"However" 表明证据并非 全无、综述已带来更新，所以缺乏证据只是"部分"原因，partly 与下文逻辑天然吻合。

【竞争词】N) traditionally "传统上"与上文"目前还没有指南"矛盾 上文 such guidelines do not yet exist for exercise and mood 讲的是"目前"的状况， traditionally 意为"传统上、历来"，时间指向错位；况且"传统上由于缺证据"读起来也不符合科 学综述的客观语气。

【易错】最具迷惑性的错误词是 N) —— traditionally 与"due to"看似自然，但与下文 However 矛 盾。traditionally 单看本句"传统上是由于缺乏证据"也成立，副词位、句法都对；防坑：副 词空务必读到下一句的逻辑词——However, a new systematic review brings us usefully up to-date 已部分推翻"缺证据"的说法，所以只能是"部分原因"partly。

【词性槽】介词 Before 后 + ___ into，需动名词

【依据】dip into = 涉足、稍稍探讨某话题 下文 Before __(29)__ into some of the key take-aways, an important __(30)__ made in the review is between aerobic exercise and anaerobic. 是过渡句——"在涉足/简略谈及 这些要点之前，先要……"。dip into 正是"稍微进入、涉足"的固定搭配，与"key take- aways（关键要点）"搭配自然，且贴合综述类文章的口吻。

【竞争词】H) falling fall into 意为"陷入/掉入"，多含被动或贬义 fall into 常表"陷入（困境/陷阱/分类）"，逻辑上不是作者主动"探讨"key take-aways，而是"掉 进去"，与作者掌控话题节奏的语气不符。

【词性槽】an important ___ made…between A and B

【依据】make a distinction between A and B = 区分 A 与 B 空后明确是 between aerobic exercise and anaerobic——在有氧与无氧之间作"区分"。 make a distinction between 是地道搭配，且下文整段都在分别解释两类运动的差别，正 是"区分"在展开。

【竞争词】C) decision make a decision 不与 between A and B 这样接"两类区分" make a decision 一般搭 about/on，且表"在 A 与 B 之间作决定"时是二选一，本文并不是 要"在有氧和无氧之间二选一"，而是要把它们"区分开"以便分别讨论。语义指向不符。

【词性槽】The former ___ such things as…，主语后缺谓语

【依据】involves such things as = 包括诸如……这样的事物 involve + such things as 是地道搭配，表"包括、涉及（举例）"。文中要表达"前者（有氧 运动）包括走路、慢跑、骑车这样的项目"，involve 既符合搭配又符合"举例罗列"的语义。

【竞争词】A) constitutes constitute 表"构成整体"，与"列举若干例"不符 constitute 的逻辑是"A、B、C 这些东西构成 X"或"X 由 A、B、C 构成"——把列举对象当成 X 的全部组分。但本句只是举"诸如"走路、慢跑、骑车这类的例子，并非穷举构成有氧运动的全部 内容，constitute 语气过死。

【词性槽】of such ___ intensity that…，定语修饰 intensity

【依据】举例"举重"+结果"来不及用氧"=高强度 原句 anaerobic exercise—such as lifting heavy weights—is of such __(32)__ intensity that your body does not have time to use oxygen to create energy：以"举重"为例， 强度大到身体来不及用氧——只有"剧烈的"vigorous 能既匹配举例又匹配结果。

【竞争词】B) contradictory contradictory 不修饰"强度" contradictory 用于"陈述/观点/结果"等，搭配 intensity 不成立；且语义上"自相矛盾的强度"也 不解释"来不及用氧"。

【词性槽】found ___ results，作 results 的前置定语

【依据】下文"有的偏高、有的偏低、还有的无差别"=互相矛盾 紧接的具体说明 Some favoured higher intensity, others low, while seven studies found that intensity made no __(34)__ to mood benefits. 一句话三种立场互相冲突—— 这正是 contradictory results"相互矛盾的研究结果"。

【词性槽】made no ___ to，固定搭配 make a difference

【依据】make no difference to = 对……毫无影响 上文 Some favoured higher intensity, others low, while seven studies found that intensity made no __(34)__ to mood benefits."有些研究偏高强度、有些偏低、还有七项 发现强度对情绪益处无影响"——difference 正好表达"无差别/无影响"的语义。

【词性槽】is ___ intensity，作 intensity 的定语

【依据】下文"低太闷、高太难受"夹出中间值 紧接的解释 perhaps because low intensity is too dull while high intensity is too unpleasant. 给了一道送分题——既排斥 low（太枯燥）又排斥 high（太难受），那"最佳 选择"自然是介于两者之间的 moderate（中等）。

【竞争词】O) vigorous vigorous = 剧烈，与"高强度太 unpleasant"矛盾 vigorous intensity 等同于 high intensity，而下文直接否定了 high intensity，故 vigorous 反 而是命题人最爱埋的诱惑项。 B) contradictory "自相矛盾的强度"不通 contradictory 修饰"结论/说法"，不修饰"强度"，搭配错位、语义也无法解读。

【易错】最具迷惑性的错误词是 O) —— vigorous 与 intensity 搭配地道，最易误选。vigorous 修 饰 intensity 在搭配上完全成立（vigorous intensity 与 vigorous exercise 都常见），不读 后半句的考生很容易顺手选它；防坑：读完 high intensity is too unpleasant 后再回头 ——高强度被否，vigorous=高强度，必排除。
